items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: I think his name was Taylor. I saw him in the picture.

ctx.x: I think his name was Taylor. I saw him in the picture. You see, the New Orleans Symphony is, truthfully, it's composed of people who are coming up or going down. You know what I mean? They don't have the New York Philharmonic or the top notches. But they're good. They come there with the symphony in their pocket. You know, I played in the symphony long enough to know. I played third trumpet in the symphony. And you'd be surprised. Third sounds is nothing. But you get tougher parts than the first guy. You hit the…
